note: Tracks tagging progress against the 100-tag taxonomy (v3). main_catalog.next_index / artiflix_catalog.next_index is the array index in data/movies.json / data/artiflix-movies.json to resume from. main_catalog is complete (1000/1000): all movies were retagged additively (existing tags kept, new ones added where applicable). artiflix_catalog is a full tagging pass from scratch (movies started with empty tags: {}) since it wasn't tagged in the original 40-tag build; movies before next_index have a complete, considered set of tags assigned from all 100.
